subject: Contract renewal: SOC 2 coverage, interim attestation options, and PO timing
messages:
From: Susan Lee <susan.lee@bluebirdhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Bluebird Procurement <procurement@bluebirdhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / renewal timing — request for latest report and interim coverage options

Hi Grace,

Quick one as we kick off procurement for our renewal/expansion: our legal and security teams need the latest SOC 2 Type II report and confirmation of coverage dates, plus (if available) an interim bridge letter covering any gap until the next Type II is complete. Our PO cutoff for this fiscal cycle is 2027-07-31; if we can't confirm coverage before that date we may need to escalate.

Can you share: 1) the most recent SOC 2 Type II PDF, 2) whether Redwood will provide a bridge/interim attestation for customers in renewal, and 3) any procurement checklist items we should loop into our PO?

Also looping in Charlie from our security team in case he wants to jump on a short call.

Thanks —
Susan
Susan Lee
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
Bluebird Health

Attachment: procurement_checklist_BBH.pdf (PDF)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@bluebirdhealth.com>
Cc: Charlie Wells <cwells@healthops.io>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / renewal timing — request for latest report and interim coverage options

Hi Susan —

Thanks for the note and the procurement checklist. Short answers up front:
- We have the SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2026-12-31 and I attached it here.
- We can provide a customer-specific bridge letter for customers who have an executed PO or committed contract language and an NDA in place; the bridge covers the period from the end of the last Type II (2026-12-31) to the start of the next coverage window (expected 2027-09-01) — final dates depend on the audit schedule.
- Im attaching a draft bridge letter template and a short Redwood procurement checklist that mirrors what procurement teams typically use.

Next steps I suggest: if you can confirm youll be able to issue the PO by 2027-07-31, we can issue a signed bridge letter within 2 business days of the PO and NDA. If procurement needs a shorter cover window we can scope that in the bridge.

CCing Markus (legal) and Marissa (compliance) to confirm any redlines or extra evidence Bluebird typically requests. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_soc2_typeii_2026.pdf (PDF); bridge_letter_template_redwood_v2.docx (DOCX)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 12:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / renewal timing — request for latest report and interim coverage options

Grace / Marissa,

Reviewed the draft bridge language — generally ok. A couple of notes: 1) we should avoid absolute language promising audit timing; instead say "expected audit cycle" and reference the reporting period. 2) add a standard limitation: bridge letters do not alter contractual obligations in the Master Services Agreement.

If Marissa is fine with the edits I'll approve & sign once Bluebird confirms PO date.

-Markus
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / renewal timing — request for latest report and interim coverage options

Markus / Grace —

Agree with Markused comments. I also recommend we include the QA evidence list (artifact types we can provide on request) and a single point of contact for technical evidence (I can be that POC). That usually helps speed procurement.

I'll prep a short evidence handoff addendum to attach to the bridge letter.

-Marissa
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@bluebirdhealth.com>
Cc: Charlie Wells <cwells@healthops.io>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / renewal timing — request for latest report and interim coverage options

Hi Susan / Charlie —

Following up with the finalized materials. Attached: 1) Redwood SOC 2 Type II (reporting period ended 2026-12-31), 2) Bridge letter (finalized with Markused clarifying language and the standard limitation clause), and 3) Redwood procurement checklist that maps to your attached PDF. Marissa will be the technical evidence POC and can provide artifact examples on request.

Action items for Bluebird:
- Confirm whether procurement can issue the PO by 2027-07-31 (if yes, we will sign and return the bridge within 2 business days).
- If PO is delayed, indicate the latest PO date you can commit to and we will scope the bridge accordingly.
- Let us know if you want a 20-min call this week to close the items.

If youre ready, I can route the bridge for signature (DocuSign link attached) as soon as you confirm the PO date.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
